nodes.name: MgO_x/MoO_y-Ru metallene synthesis
nodes.procedure: A mixture of ruthenium acetylacetonate, magnesium acetylacetonate, molybdenum acetylacetonate and potassium bromide (KBr) as a structure-directing agent was directly annealed in air. During the annealed process, the Ru^{3+} can catalyze the carbonization of acetylacetonate anion into carbon through oxygen desorption, and thus Ru^{3+} can be subsequently reduced to Ru by the generated carbon.

unit_operations.name: Annealing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: A mixture of metal acetylacetonate and potassium bromide (KBr) as a structure-directing agent was directly annealed in air.

nodes.source_text: A simple one-step salt-template approach was used to synthesize MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru metallene. A mixture of metal acetylacetonate and potassium bromide (KBr) as a structure-directing agent was directly annealed in air.

nodes.description: HER performance in 1.0 M KOH three-electrode setup
nodes.source_text: To investigate the electrocatalytic activity of MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru metallene toward HER, we deposited the metallene onto commercial carbon black, and tested it in a typical three-electrode setup in 1.0 M KOH electrolyte... The HER polarization curves display that the MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru metallene exhibits an impressive catalytic activity with a low overpotential of 8.5 mV at 10 mA cm^{-2} (Figure 3a), much lower than those of the Ru metallene (88.7 mV) and commercial Pt/C (33.6 mV). MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru metallene also delivers a high mass activity of 2.91 A mg^{-1} at an overpotential of 100 mV... After introducing MgO_x and MoO_y, the Tafel slope is lowered to 33.3 mV dec^{-1}

nodes.characterization_summary: PXRD patterns show that all the Ru-based metallenes are amorphous, in which neither Ru nor RuO2 crystal phases can be detected.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) patterns show that all the Ru-based metallenes are amorphous, in which neither Ru nor RuO2 crystal phases can be detected (Figure 1a).

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM image reveals that as-synthesized MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru metallene possesses an ultra-thin and curved nanosheet morphology.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The representative high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) image reveals that as-synthesized MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru metallene possesses an ultra-thin and curved nanosheet morphology (Figure 1b).

nodes.characterization_summary: The thickness of MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru metallene is determined as ≈0.91 nm, corresponding to four atomic layers.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Such ultrathin character of MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru metallene was further verified by the atomic force microscopy (AFM) image (Figure 1c). The thickness of MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru metallene is determined as ≈0.91 nm...

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM-EDS shows the homogenous distribution of Mg, Mo, O and Ru elements throughout the metallene.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The TEM-energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (TEM-EDS) show the homogenous distribution of Mg, Mo, O and Ru elements throughout the metallene (Figure 1e; Figures S4 and S5, Supporting Information).

nodes.characterization_summary: The Ru/Mg/Mo atomic ratio can be determined as 96.77 / 1.94 / 1.29.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ru/Mg/Mo atomic ratio can be determined as 96.77 / 1.94 / 1.29 by inductively coupled plasma-atomic emission spectroscopy (ICP-AES)...

nodes.characterization_summary: Fourier transform of EXAFS shows oxidized Mg and Mo are atomically dispersed on metallene by coordinating with Ru atoms; Ru-Ru coordination number 1.99, Ru-O coordination number 2.03.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Fourier transform of extended XAFS (EXAFS) oscillation shows that oxidized Mg and Mo are atomically dispersed on metallene by coordinating with Ru atoms (Figure 2a,b)... The EXAFS fitting reveals that the coordination numbers of Ru-Ru and Ru-O in MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru metallene are 1.99 and 2.03, respectively...

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS confirms Mg and Mo exist with oxidation states; Ru 3p peaks at 460.6 eV (Ru^0 3p_{3/2}) and 463.9 eV (Ru^{4+} 3p_{3/2}), higher binding energy than Ru metallene due to electron transfer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In addition, Mg and Mo with oxidation states exist in the metallene, confirmed by XPS (Figure S7, Supporting Information)... The peaks at 460.6 and 463.9 eV are assigned to Ru^0 (3p_{3/2}) and Ru^{4+} (3p_{3/2}), respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ FT-IR shows enhanced δH-O-H vibration mode at ≈1600 cm−1 and blue shift in νO-H vibration mode for MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru compared to Ru metallene.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ FT-IR spectra of HER on a) MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru... Compared with that of Ru metallene, the presence of MgO_x and MoO_y significantly enhances the δH-O-H vibration mode of interface water...

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman shows more prominent response at ≈1550 cm−1 for MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru than Ru metallene, characteristic fingerprint region reflecting water splitting.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ Raman results of the MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru metallene show that it exhibits a more prominent response at ≈1550 cm−1 than that of Ru metallene...

nodes.characterization_summary: Copper underpotential deposition (Cu_upd) was applied to measure the ECSA to quantitatively compare alkaline HER activities of various catalysts.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Copper underpotential deposition (Cu_upd) was applied to measure the ECSA to quantitatively compare alkaline HER activities of various catalysts (Figure S11 and Table S2, Supporting Information).

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS Nyquist and Bode plots show MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru metallene has the lowest charge-transfer resistance among the studied catalysts.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Furthermore, the Nyquist plots and Bode plots show that the MgO_x / MoO_y -Ru metallene has the lowest charge-transfer resistance among the studied catalysts...
